title: Chart
api:
type ChartConfig = Record<string, { label: string; color: string }>

type ChartType = 'bar' | 'line' | 'area' | 'donut'

type ChartDatum = Record<string, string | number | null | undefined>

interface ChartContainerProps {
  config: ChartConfig
  children: ReactElement
  className?: string
  style?: CSSProperties
}

interface ChartProps {
  data: ChartDatum[]
  config: ChartConfig
  xKey: string
  title: string
  type?: ChartType
  disabled?: boolean
  className?: string
  description?: string
  chartHeight?: number
  showLegend?: boolean
  showDataTable?: boolean
  /** Formats axis ticks only; tooltips and the data table retain the original category. */
  xAxisTickFormatter?: (value: string | number, index: number) => string
  /** Use 0 with compact tick labels to display every category in a small chart. */
  xAxisInterval?: XAxisProps['interval']
  style?: CSSProperties
}

function ChartContainer({ config, children, className, style }: ChartContainerProps);
function ChartTooltipContent({
  active,
  label,
  payload,
}: {
  active?: boolean
  label?: ReactNode
  payload?: ReadonlyArray<TooltipEntry>
});
function getDonutSlices(data: ChartDatum[], xKey: string, valueKey: string);
function Chart({
  data,
  config,
  xKey,
  title,
  type = 'bar',
  disabled = false,
  className,
  description,
  chartHeight = 240,
  showLegend = true,
  showDataTable = true,
  xAxisTickFormatter,
  xAxisInterval,
  style,
}: ChartProps);

props.name: xAxisTickFormatter
props.description: Formats axis ticks only; tooltips and the data table retain the original category.

props.name: xAxisInterval
props.description: Use 0 with compact tick labels to display every category in a small chart.

notes: Keep full category names in data. xAxisTickFormatter abbreviates only visual tick labels; tooltips and the data table preserve the original values.
xAxisInterval={0} retains every category tick. Use it with compact labels and enough plot width; the default collision-aware behavior is unchanged.
